an10.99:1.1: atha kho āyasmā upāli yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upāli bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.99:1.2: icchāmahaṃ bhante araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevitunti.
an10.99:2.1: durabhisambhavāni kho upāli araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni,
an10.99:2.3: ekatte haranti maññe mano vanāni samādhiṃ alabhamānassa bhikkhuno.
an10.99:2.5: ‘ahaṃ samādhiṃ alabhamāno araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevissā mi’ti. tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an10.99:3.2: atha āgaccheyya hatthināgo sattaratano vā aṭṭharatano vā.
an10.99:3.4: ‘yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷeyyaṃ, piṭṭhisandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷeyyaṃ.
an10.99:3.5: kaṇṇasandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷitvā piṭṭhisandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷitvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkhameyya’nti.
an10.99:3.6: so udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷeyya. piṭṭhisandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷeyya.
an10.99:3.7: kaṇṇasandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷitvā piṭṭhisandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷitvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyya.
an10.99:4.1: atha āgaccheyya saso vā biḷāro vā.
an10.99:4.4: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷeyyaṃ piṭṭhisandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷeyyaṃ
an10.99:4.5: kaṇṇasandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷitvā piṭṭhisandhopikampi khiḍḍaṃ kīḷitvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyyanti.
an10.99:4.10: paritto hupāli attabhāvo gambhīre gādhaṃ na vindati.
an10.99:4.11: evameva kho upāli yo evaṃ vadeyya:
an10.99:4.12: ahaṃ samādhiṃ alabhamāno araññe vanapatthāni pattāni senāsanāni paṭisevissāmī ti. tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ,
an10.99:5.1: seyyathāpi upāli daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sakena muttakarīsena kīḷati,
an10.99:6.1: sa kho so upāli kumāro aparena samayena vuddhimanvāya indriyānaṃ paripākamanvāya
an10.99:6.2: yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kīḷāpanakāni bhavanti. seyyathīdaṃ: vaṅkakaṃ, ghaṭikaṃ, mokkhacikaṃ, ciṅgulakaṃ pattāḷhakaṃ, rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ, tehi kīḷati.
an10.99:6.4: nanvāyaṃ khiḍḍā purimāya khiḍḍāya abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā cāti?
an10.99:7.1: sakho so upāli kumāro aparena samayena vuddhimanvāya indriyānaṃ paripākamanvāya
an10.99:7.3: cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi,
an10.99:7.7: kāya viññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piya rūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi,
an10.99:7.9: nanvāyaṃ khiḍḍā purimāhi khiḍḍāhi abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā cāti?
an10.99:8.1: idhaṃ kho pana vo upāli tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā:
an10.99:8.2: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
an10.99:8.3: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevala paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an10.99:9.1: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto
an10.99:9.2: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati,
an10.99:9.5: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekanta parisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
an10.99:9.6: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
an10.99:10.1: so aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
an10.99:11.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihita daṇḍo nihitasattho lajji dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtānukampī viharati.
an10.99:12.1: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena suci bhūtena attanā viharati.
an10.99:13.1: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā,
an10.99:14.1: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa,
an10.99:15.1: pisunaṃvācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. na ito sutvā amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya, iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
an10.99:16.1: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. yā sā vācā neḷā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
an10.99:17.1: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
an10.99:19.1: so santuṭṭho hoti kāyapārihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena
an10.99:19.3: seyyathāpi pakkhīsakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti, sapattabhārova ḍeti.
an10.99:19.4: evameva bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyapārihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena yena yeneva pakkamati, samādāyeva pakkamati
an10.99:19.5: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti:
an10.99:20.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hotī nānubyañjanaggāhī.
an10.99:20.2: yatvādhikaraṇametaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an10.99:20.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti, nānubyañjanaggāhī,
an10.99:20.8: yatvādhikaraṇametaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an10.99:20.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an10.99:21.1: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti. uccāra passāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti. gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti. .
an10.99:22.1: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato
an10.99:22.2: vicittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
an10.99:22.3: so araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an10.99:23.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati. abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
an10.99:23.2: vyāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī, vyāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
an10.99:23.3: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigata thīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno, thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
an10.99:23.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
an10.99:23.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
an10.99:24.1: so ime pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
an10.99:24.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.99:24.4: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti?
an10.99:25.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti. no ca kho tāva anuppatta sadatthā viharanti.
an10.99:26.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.99:26.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā ti?
an10.99:27.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti. no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti.
an10.99:28.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an10.99:28.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītatarocā ti?
an10.99:29.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti. no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti.
an10.99:30.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, taṃ kiṃ maññasi upāli nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā ti? evaṃ bhante. imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti. no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti.
an10.99:31.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu sabbaso rūpa saññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.99:31.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantaro ca paṇītataro cāti?
an10.99:32.1: imampi kho upāli, mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti. no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti.
an10.99:33.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati: …pe…
an10.99:34.1: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcī ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an10.99:35.1: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘santametaṃ, paṇītameta’nti nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an10.99:35.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti?
an10.99:36.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti. no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti.
an10.99:37.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
an10.99:37.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā ti?
an10.99:38.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti. no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti.
